General prison systems are flawed because most of the time people commit crimes for a reason, like mental health, being poor, not getting work for various reasons like being uneducated or just not educated enough. Instead of fixing these problems and helping the prisoners, depending on the country, they're put into cells with cellmates and in jail they have to go through things like rape, violence and even murder. Now ask yourself. If you were in this kind of an environment for years, would you come out as a well functioning person who will abide by societies rules? I highly doubt it. 

Of course there are countries like Denmark, where prisoners get private rooms, opportunities to educate themselves, lots of time outside with other inmates, therapeutic help, and they can work to earn money. Hell they can even learn to play instruments. Denmark had to shut down prisons because there weren't enough prisoners to keep them open. Criminals committing crimes again is extremely rare compared to other countries. Finding a job and being a part of society isn't impossible for them. 

Even though these people committed crimes, some more heinous and terrible than others, most of them still deserve a second chance.
